definitions.full: H2431. Chelam חֵילָם proper name, of a location east of Jordan 2Sam 10:16 (Th their army , but ᵑ7 ᵑ6 ᵐ5 Ew Geschichte. iii. 211 Anm. 1 = H iii. 155 n. 2 We Dr) = חֵלָ֑א֯מָה 10:17 ( ᵐ5 Αιλαμ ); + חילם Ezek 47:16 ( ᵐ5 Ηλιαμ ) Co; according to this it lay on the border between Damascus and Hamath.
